adminDeletedWorkspaces.title: Deleted workspaces
adminDeletedWorkspaces.description: Workspaces whose state is still recoverable. Restoring one creates a new workspace holding the recovered state — it is not an undo, and the window is limited.
adminDeletedWorkspaces.empty: No deleted workspaces have recoverable state.
adminDeletedWorkspaces.restoreConfirm:
Restore the state of "{name}"?

This creates a NEW workspace — the original is not brought back. It returns with auto-apply and drift detection off and no VCS connection, and its variables and run history do not come back. Only the state is recovered.
adminDeletedWorkspaces.restoreDone: Recovered {versions, plural, one {# state version} other {# state versions}} into the new workspace "{name}". Check its settings before enabling auto-apply or VCS.
adminDeletedWorkspaces.restoreAgainConfirm:
"{name}" has already been restored, into {existing}.

Restoring it again creates a SECOND workspace holding the same state lineage over the same infrastructure. Applying in either will then make the other's next plan look like wholesale drift.

Only continue if the earlier restored workspace is gone.
